# Vasileios Fasoulas

Product Engineering Leader. London, UK.
https://fasoulas.com/

> Product Engineering leadership for orgs that build platforms, not just features.

A leader with over two decades building and operating teams, scalable platforms, and digital products across start-ups, scale-ups and enterprise environments.

From fast-moving, hands-on product teams to globally distributed programmes of 100+ people; with architecture expertise that moves between hands-on delivery and long-range strategy, tested across multiple stacks and clouds.

Recent focus on AI-native and agentic software development: AI-assisted engineering workflows, autonomous agent systems, LLM orchestration, and spec-driven approaches that tighten the loop between product and engineering.

A consistent view across two decades of change: stacks and frameworks turn over, but peopleware, product thinking and execution discipline are what actually make digital products and orgs successful.

- GitHub: https://github.com/fasoulas

https://www.sliide.com

https://www.digitas.co.uk
